items.problem: DataTemplate x:Bind with x:DataType="local:Scenario" failed to compile (WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType' + WMC1111 + internal WMC9999); the dev-agent recovered by switching to classic {Binding Title}.
items.evidence: session-log.txt:2236-2238 (WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999) and the fix at 2299 replacing x:Bind/x:DataType with {Binding Title}.
items.covered_clearly_at: This is a one-off XAML-compiler resolution quirk on a ported ItemTemplate, not a documented migration pattern. The dev-agent diagnosed and fixed it in a single turn with a correct, standard fallback ({Binding}). No general skill rule would reliably pre-empt the internal WMC9999, and forcing a blanket x:Bind->Binding rule would be wrong guidance (x:Bind is the recommended default).
items.why_no_skill_change: A capable model already recovered correctly in one step; the failure is scenario/compiler-specific (internal WMC9999) rather than a generalizable pattern, and encoding 'prefer {Binding} over x:Bind' would degrade guidance for other scenarios. Not worth a skill edit.
